sourcePolicy: Root ran the recorded escalated two-worker command in the isolated audit worktree. All agents were instructed to keep production sources frozen throughout; root observed no production edits there. At completion git diff against the pinned revision for the listed production/detector/corpus paths is empty. Added capture, assessment and evidence files are outside this detector source. This is a controlled-run completion attestation, not a per-worker source snapshot or cryptographic proof of past filesystem contents.
